title: The Early Bird
summary: A bird watcher is found stabbed. The 'how' is the biggest puzzle of the case as it's not obvious how the victim was murdered when everyone seemingly had an alibi at the time of the murder.
method: The victim was killed earlier and the killer walked with the victim's cane to impersonate him. There was an accomplice who woke up another bird watcher so that he would testify that the victim was alive at that time.
motive: The killer was about to be discovered as a criminal involved in a string of rare egg thefts. The victim told the accomplice and was about to inform the authorities, not knowing that the accomplice and killer knew each other.
killer: Two of the other birdwatchers, who have met in the past.
